rows.abstract: "Philippine Immigration and Naturalization Act of 1993" Highlights these  salient features: (1) effective decentralizati on  of   the Bureau`s functions through the creation of IMMIGRATION AND NATURALIZATION DISTRICTS; (2) establishment of TRAVEL CONTROL DISTRICTS with jurisdiction over international airports; (3) legalization of residence and naturalization of qualified foreign nationals; (4) granting the Bureau prerogative to determine and recognize claims of citizenship. * * *
